input.action: t.npc_data = q.player.get_npc_data(q.npc); t.next_page = t.npc_data.item_gave == 1 ? 'item_gave' : 'line_1'; v.item_gave_line = t.npc_data.item_gave == 1 ? t.npc_data.item_gave_line : ''; q.dialogue.set_page(t.next_page)

pages.speaker: npc
lines: Thank you for saving Silph! I will never forget you saved us in our moment of peril!

pages.speaker: npc
lines: I have to thank you in some way! Because I am rich, I can give you anything!
input: v.item_gave_line = v.item_id == 'cobblemon:master_ball' ? 'You cant buy that anywhere! It is our secret prototype Master Ball! It will catch any Pokémon without fail! You should be quiet about using it, though.' : 'I hope these gifts from my personal vault can reward our hero a little bit!';
